title: Final answer for v1
description: Essential: Correctly states the maximum velocity with switch closed as v1 = mgR/(B^2 L^2).

title: Final answer for v2
description: Essential: Correctly states the maximum velocity with switch open as v2 = 3mgR/(2 B^2 L^2).

title: Final answer for a
description: Essential: Correctly states the acceleration magnitude after opening S as a = g/2.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Applies the condition that at terminal velocity, the magnetic force balances gravity (mg = BIL).

title: Non-linear component property
description: Important: Correctly uses the property that when current I >= I0, the voltage across Z is Um.

title: Circuit analysis for v2
description: Important: For the open switch case, correctly applies Kirchhoff's loop rule (BLv2 = Um + I2R) and Ohm's law.

title: Instantaneous analysis for a
description: Important: After opening S at v1, correctly calculates the new current from E1, Um, and R, then finds net force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Expresses all answers using only the allowed symbols (m, g, B, L, R) and checks dimensional consistency.

title: Sign error in force
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong direction for magnetic force (e.g., mg + BIL = ma) leading to incorrect acceleration.

title: Misapplied component condition
description: Pitfall: Assumes voltage Um across Z when current is below I0, or incorrectly uses I0 in calculations.
